description: This Kotlin source file defines classes, interfaces, and functions for handling motion activity and pedometer data on Android devices, including sensor data collection, activity classification, and permission checks.

classes.name: MotionActivityRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request for motion activity data with optional start and end ISO timestamps and a limit.

classes.name: MotionPedometerRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request for pedometer data with optional start and end ISO timestamps.

classes.name: MotionActivityRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a recorded motion activity with timestamps, confidence, and activity type flags.

classes.name: PedometerRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a pedometer record with timestamps, steps, distance, and floors data.

classes.name: MotionDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for checking availability, permissions, and retrieving motion activity and pedometer data.

classes.name: SystemMotionDataSource
classes.description: Singleton object implementing MotionDataSource, providing sensor-based motion data retrieval and classification.

classes.name: MotionHandler
classes.description: Main class handling motion activity and pedometer requests, including permission checks, request parsing, and response formatting.

methods.name: handleMotionActivity
methods.description: Handles motion activity requests, checks permissions, invokes data source, and returns JSON result.

methods.name: handleMotionPedometer
methods.description: Handles pedometer data requests, checks permissions, invokes data source, and returns JSON result.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if motion data capability is available.

methods.name: isActivityAvailable
methods.description: Checks if activity data is available.

methods.name: isPedometerAvailable
methods.description: Checks if pedometer data is available.

methods.name: parseActivityRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into MotionActivityRequest object.

methods.name: parsePedometerRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into MotionPedometerRequest object.
